rows.title_full: AN ACT PROVIDING FOR A SYSTEM OF DETERMINING THE MINIMUM FOOD REQUIREMENTS OF FILIPINOS, REORGANIZING THE NATIONAL FOOD AUTHORITY, ESTABLISHING THE NATIONAL STRATEGIC FOOD SUPPLY AND RESERVE CORPORATION AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.title_short: Food For Filipinos First Act
rows.abstract: Requires the Department of Agriculture (DA) to define and put together a Food Requirement Plan for Filipinos, ensuring that all Filipinos are able to eat from what is locally produced first before exporting our produce to the international market.

committee_action.meethigh: The Technical Working Group was created , to be headed by Rep. Agapito Guanlao, to harmonize the bills and discuss related food security issues that need legislation.

As a result of the series of public hearings,particularly in Tuguegarao, Cagayan, General Santos City and Cebu City, the Joint Committee came up with a draft substitute bill which was presented to the Body for further deliberation. Amendments were introduced and the draft was thereby approved with all members present as co-authors. The Secretariat was directed to finalize the bill; send the final draft to the National Food Authority (NFA), Governance Commission for GOCCs (GCC), Department of Budget and Management (DBM), Department of Finance, (DoF), and relevant agencies for their comments and recommendations; and set a clarificatory meeting of the joint panel with the concerned agencies.

Position papers and recommendations from the concerned agencies, particularly the National Food Authority (NFA), Governance Commission for GOCCs (GCGs), Department of Budget and Management (DBM), Department of Finance (DoF) and other relevant agencies, were presented to the Body  for possible amendments to the draft substitute bill.

rows.author: E040;

rows.title_full: AN ACT GRANTING EXEMPTION TO THE PUBLIC SCHOOL EDUCATORS AND EDUCATION PERSONNEL FROM THE COVERAGE OF REPUBLIC ACT 6758, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE SALARY STANDARDIZATION LAW AND AUTHORIZING THE APPROPRIATIONS OF FUNDS THEREFOR
rows.abstract: Provides for the granting of exemption to eligible public school educators and education personnel from the Salary Standardization Law (SSL), calling for the formulation of a comprehensive and competitive salary structure, independent from the SSL.

committee_action.meethigh: Referred to the Department of Budget and Management for position paper.

committee_action.action: Under deliberation by the Mother Committee on 2014-08-05
committee_action.meethigh: For further deliberation.

rows.author: E040;
rows.title_full: AN ACT CREATING A COMPREHENSIVE PROFESSIONAL DEVELOPMENT FOR ELEMENTARY SCHOOL HEADS IN EARLY CHILDHOOD EDUCATION AND DEVELOPMENT AND APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR
rows.abstract: Aims to ensure effective implementation of early childhood education and development initiatives in the local level by upgrading the knowledge and managerial skills of the elementary school heads on the creation of quality early learning environment, provision for relevant curriculum application of best practices in early childhood teaching, and strengthening linkages with stakeholders.
rows.status: Under study by the Technical Working Group(TWG) on 2014-01-28

committee_action.remarks: Referred to the DepED for comment.

committee_action.action: Under deliberation by the Mother Committee on 2013-12-03
Under study by the Technical Working Group(TWG) on 2014-01-28
committee_action.remarks: The author was informed that letters requesting the comment/position of concerned stakeholders (DepED, E-Net, ECCD) were sent on even date.

rows.author: E040;
rows.title_full: AN ACT PROVIDING FURTHER BENEFITS TO PUBLIC SCHOOL EDUCATORS IN FORM OF DISCOUNT PRIVILEGES, PROVIDING THE MECHANICS FOR ITS IMPLEMENTATION, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: Seeks to provide the public school educators non-wage benefits in the form of special discounts on private establishments, medicines, restaurants, fares and other business institutions.

committee_action.remarks: Referred to the DepED for comment.

rows.author: E040;
rows.title_full: AN ACT REQUIRING AUTOMATIC EXPENDITURE FOR MEDICAL EXAMINATION AND TREATMENT OF PUBLIC SCHOOL EDUCATORS AND EMPLOYEES IN THE ANNUAL GENERAL APPROPRIATIONS ACT AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: Provides public school teaching and non-teaching personnel with compulsory medical attention and treatment, free of charge.

committee_action.meethigh: Referred to the Department of Budget and Management for position paper.

rows.author: E040;
rows.title_full: AN ACT INSTITUTIONALIZING SCHOLARSHIP GRANTS TO PUBLIC SCHOOL EDUCATORS AND THEIR CHILDREN AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: Seeks to accord public school educators additional benefits through the institutionalization of scholarship grants and extending the same benefits to their children.

committee_action.remarks: Referred to the DepED for comment.

rows.author: E040;
rows.title_full: AN ACT CREATING PLANTILLA POSITION IN THE DEPARTMENT OF EDUCATION FOR VOLUNTEER EDUCATORS WITH AT LEAST FIVE YEARS OF CONTINUOUS SERVICE IN THE PUBLIC SCHOOL SYSTEM AND APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR
rows.abstract: Creates plantilla positions to qualified volunteer educators who have continuously served for at least five (5) years, to give them adequate income, accord them the dignity they deserve as practitioners of the profession, and thereby strengthening the spirit of volunteerism as inherent goodness of the Filipino race.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on APPROPRIATIONS since 2013-07-23

rows.author: E040;
rows.title_full: AN ACT PRESCRIBING THE CRIME OF DEFECTIVE TEXTBOOK PUBLICATION, PROVIDING FOR PREVENTION, SUPPRESSION AND IMPOSITION OF PENALTIES THEREFOR AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: States that defective textbooks are those that are filled with errors and omission, defects that point to the accuracy and validity of contents as the textbooks contain factual and conceptual errors, or even grammatical errors, as well as biases and prejudices that can cause undue influence and negative effects to the value system of students and other individuals who read them.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on JUSTICE since 2013-07-23

rows.author: E040;
rows.title_full: AN ACT PROVIDING GUIDELINES FOR THE ESTABLISHMENT AND OPERATION OF LOCAL COLLEGES AND UNIVERSITIES, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: States that the Local College or University (LCU) refers to a public higher education institution (HEI) established in a local government unit (LGU) through an establishing ordinance and financially supported by the concerned LGU.
rows.status: Under deliberation by the Mother Committee on 2013-11-20

committee_action.action: Under deliberation by the Mother Committee on 2013-11-20
committee_action.remarks: For TWG deliberation

rows.author: E040;
rows.title_full: AN ACT STRENGTHENING THE INFORMATION AND COMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY TRAINING PROGRAM FOR BASIC EDUCATION TEACHERS PROVIDING CERTAIN POLICIES AND MECHANISMS FOR ITS IMPLEMENTATION
rows.abstract: Aims to institute certain policies and mechanisms that will strengthen training programs for teachers that will provide them significant knowledge and skills on information and communication technology (ICT), enabling them to apply computer-aided teaching methodologies and digital tools and techniques in their classroom activities.
rows.status: Recommendations submitted by the TWG on 2014-01-28

committee_action.remarks: Referred to the DepED for comment.

Recommendations submitted by the TWG on 2014-01-28

rows.author: E040;
rows.title_full: AN ACT RECOGNIZING THE VITAL ROLE OF SCHOOL HEADS AS THE CHIEF EXECUTIVES OF BASIC EDUCATION GOVERNANCE AT THE SCHOOL LEVEL WHICH RENDERS THEM HIGHLY-RELIABLE AND MOST DEPENDABLE TO BECOMING MEMBERS OF THE LOCAL SCHOOL BOARDS, AMENDING IN VIEW THEREOF, REPUBLIC ACT 7160, AS AMENDED, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE `LOCAL GOVERNMENT CODE OF 1991´
rows.abstract: Includes THE DULY ELECTED REPRESENTATIVE OF ALL PUBLIC SCHOOL HEADS IN THE PROVINCE as members in the provincial school boards.

committee_action.remarks: Referred to the DepED for comment.

rows.author: E040;
rows.title_full: AN ACT CREATING THE COMMUNITY SCHOOL BOARDS
rows.abstract: Aims to strengthen governance of public basic education at the local level by providing the creation of Community School Board in a barangay or within the cluster or group of barangays which will be constituted in accordance with certain provisions under this Act.

committee_action.remarks: Referred to the DepED for comment.

rows.author: E040;
rows.mother_status: Republic Act RA10767 enacted on 2016-04-26
rows.title_full: AN ACT PROHIBITING SPITTING IN PUBLIC PLACES, APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: Seeks to prohibit spitting in public places to prevent tuberculosis (TB) and other contagious and airborne diseases and thereby spreading environmental and health consciousness among the citizens apart from changing societal habits and lifestyles.

rows.author: E040;
rows.title_full: AN ACT PROHIBITING COLLECTION OR SOLICITATION OF FEES FOR THE USE OF COMFORT ROOMS IN COMMERCIAL AREAS APPROPRIATING FUNDS AND PROVIDING MECHANISMS THEREFOR
rows.abstract: Prohibits the collection or solicitation of fees from any person using comfort rooms in commercial areas in order to give access of basic services to the public especially the underprivileged, persons with disabilities (PWD) and senior citizens.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on TRADE AND INDUSTRY since 2013-07-23
